classification_policy.shared_master_rule: A reframe unit is BLOCKED_OTHER until its exact raster master exists and independently passes pixel review; approval never inherits from the future master.
classification_policy.sacred_scene_rule: Scenes that fix source-silent Brahma, Vishnu, Shesha or Yoganidra iconography remain under source/iconography review rather than inheriting the complete story spine.
